other_conditions: Must have secured at least 70% marks in the 12th examination conducted by the Board of Secondary Education, or at least 85% marks in the 12th examination conducted by CBSE/ICSE.

Must have secured a rank up to 150,000 in JEE Mains and taken admission in a BE/B.Tech program, or have taken NEET for admission to MBBS/BDS, or have taken admission in a law course through CLAT, or have taken admission in Central Government medical institutions based on other entrance examinations, or have taken admission to a law course at the National Law Institute Delhi or the University of Delhi based on a personal entrance examination.
benefits_summary: The scheme reimburses the admission fee and actual tuition fee (excluding mess fee and caution money) as approved by the Fee Regulatory Committee or the relevant university/government authority.
